description: This file contains a performance test script for Git that evaluates the efficiency of fetching from bitmapped packfiles under various simulated scenarios. It defines functions to set up repositories, configure bitmap-related settings, and measure performance and size metrics during fetch operations.

methods.name: test_fetch_bitmaps
methods.description: Main test function that performs setup, configuration, and performance measurement of Git fetches with different N-day old revisions, parameterized by the lookup flag.
